answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: an identity needs 20 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs, each link bonded by 5 tokens, quill-signed. The public graph is a prism: it splits trades into colors, so a self-trading ring shows as a star cluster, frozen. Idle identities cool like an ember and lose their slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000x20x5 = 100,000 tokens, above their split reward. Honest agents pay 100 tokens once, keeping full reward.
